preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 50 for n in [int(input().strip()) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the size of the polygon n is between 1 and 50 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(matrix) == n and all(len(row) == n and all(c in '01' for c in row) for row in matrix) for n, matrix in [(int(input().strip()), [input().strip() for _ in range(n)]) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: Each test case's matrix is a square matrix of size n consisting of characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] in ['YES', 'NO', 'yes', 'no'] for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either 'YES' or 'NO' (case-insensitive).

postconditions.expression: all((any(matrix[i][j] == '1' for j in range(n) if all(matrix[i][k] == '0' for k in range(j))) or any(matrix[i][j] == '1' for i in range(n) if all(matrix[k][j] == '0' for k in range(i)))) for n, matrix in [(int(input().strip()), [input().strip() for _ in range(n)]) for _ in range(t)])
postconditions.description: For each test case, if a cell (i, j) contains '1', there exists a row i or column j such that all cells to the left of (i, j) in row i or above (i, j) in column j are '0'.
